page.overview:
Who is Darth Sakia?

Darth Sakia was a fictional female Dark Lord of the Sith created by Jedi Master Lene Kostana, hoping that it would make Jedi Initiate Dooku remember a Force vision that he had seen when he broke into the Archive of Forbidden Artifacts, an artifact collection located in the planet Coruscant's Jedi Temple. Dooku faced Kostana in a duel, convinced that the Master was secretly a Sith Lord. While fighting, Kostana said that, like Dooku himself, Darth Sakia was a skilled swordswoman who used a curved hilt lightsaber. When Jedi Grand Master Yoda joined them on the contemplation balcony where they were dueling, he assured Dooku that Sakia was fictitious.

Dooku later told his sister, Jenza, about the events in a holo-letter. Dooku gave several data disks containing his messages to Jenza to his recently recruited Sith assassin—Asajj Ventress—for her investigation into his sister's location, and she listened to the holo-disk that mentioned Sakia.

Darth Sakia was first mentioned in a flashback in the audio drama Dooku: Jedi Lost, written by Cavan Scott The spelling of Darth Sakia was confirmed by the audio drama's script release on October 1 of the same year.
